 Charting the Unknown Market Availability Update 
 Oct 30, 2026, 05:35 (UTC)
 Facebook 
 X 
 Hello, Greymanes. 
 We would like to provide an update regarding the availability of Crimson Desert's DLC, Charting the Unknown, in Saudi Arabia. 
 Following our recent submission and prompt clearance by GMEDIA, we are pleased to announce that the DLC has received official approval. Preparations are now underway to make it available for purchase across digital platforms in the Kingdom. 
 We appreciate GMEDIA's swift review and cooperation, and we thank our community in Saudi Arabia for their patience and support. Stay tuned for availability details on your platform of choice!
